items.question: What claim about the scale of suffering must hold if beings are tormented across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: A fixed count of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams is in view.
Those womb-diagrams form the locations of confinement.
Beings situated there are described as tormented.
items.inference: The extent of torment is measured by confinement within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The precise scope of yoniyantreṣu remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
